rulings.item: divergence 1 (holds_wrongly) at t=1000 ms: With clearance set to zero metres, x enters r at the judged observation. Its distance is zero, hence at clearance rather than below it; the body nevertheless holds because it omits the distance test at the entry. — contract: fails, body: holds; contract: "at every observation from that entry up to the observation the ground distance from x's body outline to r (st.region_geometry, m, world frame; zero while the footprint overlaps r) has stayed below clearance"
rulings.why: The contract says unconditionally that the state becomes true at an entry, and the record discloses the reading that the distance is not tested at the entry observation. That is a choice among the meanings the contract's words allow. The divergence also arises only because the caller set clearance to zero, so it turns on the size of a parameter the caller sets. — "It becomes true at an entry, holds while x stays on r or within clearance of it"

advisories: A tested first observation with fully observed distance greater than a positive clearance returned fails, agreeing with the contract; it supplies no divergence.
